desc: Build the component merge tree: when merging two components at height h, create a new node with children being the two component IDs, and store the height h for the new node. The root is the final component (all cells). Total nodes O(H*W).
Preprocess the tree: compute depth, parent, and prefix sum of heights along the root-to-node path. Also compute binary lifting ancestors for LCA queries.

For each query, find the component ID of the start cell at floor Y and the end cell at floor Z using the history (binary search). Then compute the distance between these two nodes in the tree as |prefix[start] + prefix[end] - 2*prefix[lca]|, which gives the sum of absolute height differences along the path. This is the minimum stair moves.
Test on sample input and verify correctness.
Analyze problem and identify key observations (horizontal moves free, cost only from vertical moves, component structure changes at cell heights)
Implement component history preprocessing: sort cells by height descending, use union-find with persistent IDs, store per-cell list of (height, comp_id)
